purpose: Breakdown of the 8M Gemini API calls and ~$19.6K spend by workload type (OCR, translation, etc). Source: gemini_usage_daily aggregation.

workloads.label: Translation
workloads.description: Long-form passage translation. Source language → English. Page-credit accounting backfilled May 2026 (PR #2006); now 1.83 pages/call avg.

workloads.label: OCR
workloads.description: Image-to-text transcription. Multimodal: image input, structured text output. Some pages get multiple OCR passes (drift-fallback, quality retries).

workloads.label: Image extraction
workloads.description: Detecting illustrations, plates, diagrams in scanned pages and extracting bounding boxes + captions.

workloads.label: Index
workloads.description: Extracting concepts, names, topics for book indexes. Operates over whole books.

workloads.label: Per-page translate
workloads.description: Single-page translation, lighter context than long-form. Mostly used for shorter pieces and incremental work.

workloads.label: Transliteration
workloads.description: Script-to-script conversion (e.g., Hebrew → Latin transliteration, Greek → Latin transliteration).

workloads.label: Chapters
workloads.description: Detecting chapter boundaries across long books.

workloads.label: Other
workloads.description: ft_verification, summary, image_extraction, metadata_enrichment, quality-scoring, summarize, collection-assignment, entity_enrichment.
